description: Version uploads, policy-head recovery, retired epoch refusal and refreshed-epoch recovery.

producer.crypto: Public test-only broker JWKs and deterministic fixture entropy. All verification uses real WebCrypto.

test_only_keys.warning: PUBLIC TEST-ONLY PRIVATE KEYS. Never use for deployment.

response.body: {"ok":false,"code":"E_POLICY_HEAD","error":"tw: policy conflict","next":"Check the request and try again."}

limitations: The retired KEK is refused on signed broker HTTP with E_ENROLLMENT: the production authority wrapper normalizes the nested E_STALE_EPOCH exception. No protocol change was made to expose that internal code.
